title: Clarify scope & ownership for runtime telemetry privacy changes
creator: Aisha Patel
summary: This ticket formalizes cross-team alignment for a small-scope PRD change: we will update runtime telemetry (prefix/KV cache metrics + sampling) to include a privacy opt-out and revised retention policy. The goal is to finalize acceptance criteria, assign clear owners for engineering/design/legal tasks, and lock a release gating checklist so the feature can ship without compliance risk.
description: Background: During the runtime-1.20 PRD grooming, product identified subtle privacy concerns about the new prefix/KV cache telemetry (stack traces and token position heatmaps). The engineering proposal reduced sampling granularity but left retention and PII heuristics underspecified. Legal requested a mapping of collected fields and a retention proposal before signoff. Design needs to show UX for per-tenant telemetry opt-out and the console visibility for customers.
decision_rationale: We prefer a conservative approach: ship with reduced granularity and a default 30-day retention window for derived telemetry, provide a per-tenant opt-out control in Console, and add an explicit data dictionary for telemetry fields. This minimizes customer impact while keeping signals for operational SLOs.
open_questions: Should stack traces be redacted or entirely excluded from exported telemetry?
Do we need a separate retention policy for CUstomer-managed Private deployments?
Is a legal-only review sufficient or do we need external counsel for EU customers?
acceptance_criteria: Legal has signed off on data dictionary and retention policy (artifact link in 'artifacts').
Design has produced final Console mockups for opt-out and telemetry visibility; mocks annotated and approved by PM.
Engineering has a validated API contract for telemetry toggles and a feature flag for gradual rollout (PR link).
E2E test demonstrating opt-out prevents persisted telemetry for a sample tenant is green in CI.
Release gating checklist completed: docs, telemetry dashboards updated, rollback runbook, and customer communication draft.
Telemetry retention enforcement implemented and tested on staging with synthetic data.
A follow-up audit plan for 90-day post-release compliance check is scheduled and owned.

final_note: This ticket is intentionally scoped to operational telemetry changes (no user content capture). If the scope expands to include prompt/response-level logs, we will abort this flow and create a separate PRD with expanded compliance controls.
